body.name: W_hat_loc
body.construction:
Fix a population raw branch \(W\) and a radius \(r>0\) such that the closed Frobenius ball \(\mathcal B_r(W)=\{U:\lVert U-W\rVert_F\leq r\}\) contains no other zero of \(F_{\mathrm{res}}(\,cdot\,;z)\).  For a moment vector \(\zeta\), whenever
\[
 \underset{U\in\mathcal B_r(W)}{\operatorname{argmin}}\,
 \lVert F_{\mathrm{res}}(U;\zeta)\rVert_2^2
\]
is a singleton, define \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{loc}}(\zeta)\) to be its unique element.  Define a total measurable completion by taking the unique argmin when it is a singleton and assigning the fixed population-indexed fallback \(W\) otherwise.  Any measurable completion agreeing with the unique argmin on its singleton region is denoted \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{loc}}\).
